description: Source code for the TargetGenerator class in the GN build system, responsible for generating build targets based on scope and function call inputs.

classes.name: TargetGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating build targets in GN based on scope and function call inputs.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the target generation process, filling dependencies, data, metadata, and performing type-specific generation.

methods.name: GenerateTarget
methods.description: Static method to generate a build target of a specified type based on scope, function call, and arguments.

methods.name: GetBuildSettings
methods.description: Returns the build settings associated with the scope.

methods.name: FillSources
methods.description: Fills the source files for the target from scope variables.

methods.name: FillPublic
methods.description: Fills public headers for the target.

methods.name: FillConfigs
methods.description: Fills configuration variables for the target.

methods.name: FillData
methods.description: Fills data files for the target.

methods.name: FillDependencies
methods.description: Fills dependency lists for the target.

methods.name: FillTestonly
methods.description: Sets the test-only flag for the target.

methods.name: FillAssertNoDeps
methods.description: Fills the assert no dependencies pattern.

methods.name: FillOutputs
methods.description: Fills output file patterns for the target.

methods.name: EnsureSubstitutionIsInOutputDir
methods.description: Validates that a substitution pattern is within the output directory.

methods.name: FillWriteRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Sets the runtime dependencies output file.
